title: Observational study to evaluate the use of cannabis extract (THC/CBD) for non-motor symptoms in Parkinson's patients
summary:
Non-interventional observational study on 200 Parkinson's patients who were adjusted to a medicinal cannabis extract (10:10 - THC:CBD) in a patient-specific dosage by their treating physician.
Baseline data and symptom scores were collected before the start of the study, over the course of 5 weeks and after 12 weeks.

interventions.name: 200 Parkinson's patients who were prescribed medicinal cannabis extract (10:10) by their treating physician to treat the target symptoms (pain, sleep disorders, depression, stress and anxiety).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Parkinson's disease
non-motor disorders (pain, sleep disorders, depression, stress and anxiety)
Consent to therapy with medicinal cannabis
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy/breastfeeding period
Existing care according to § 1814 BGB
